# Contact CenterPoint.
Call [773.728.0652](tel:+17737280652), email [service@centerpointmgmt.com](mailto:service@centerpointmgmt.com), or visit 5107 N Western Ave, Suite 1S, Chicago. Office hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

## Choose the right form.

Questions, records, account help, or anything that does not fit a form above. We reply within one business day.

- **[773.728.0652](tel:+17737280652)** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
